newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-RONALDO, SHEARER OR WEAH WILL WIN FIFA WORLD PLAYER AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO, SHEARER OR WEAH WILL WIN FIFA WORLD PLAYER AWARD.

text.p: FIFA's 1996 world footballer of the year will be either Barcelona striker Ronaldo, Alan Shearer of Newcastle or AC Milan's George Weah.
The three players gained the greatest number of votes in a poll of more than 100 national team coaches, soccer's world governing body FIFA announced at a news conference on Wednesday.
If Weah wins, it will be the second year running he has taken the award, and he would receive it together with a FIFA trophy for fair play at a ceremony in Lisbon on January 20.

FIFA chairman Joao Havelange said on Friday the Liberian striker would still receive the fair play award despite his attack on Porto captain Jorge Costa after a European Champions' League match last month.
Havelange said Weah had been provoked into the assault which left Costa with a broken nose.

The Liberian faces stiff competition from dazzling Brazilian Ronaldo, who has scored some spectacular goals for Barcelona this season, and England striker Alan Shearer, who was top scorer in June's European championship.

Barcelona are reported to have doubled Ronaldo's salary recently in a deal to keep the young striker at the club until 2006 while Shearer remains the world's most expensive player following his $23.3 million move to Newcastle in the summer.
